field_notes: validated_* names the last modelctl+llama.cpp pair that passed hardware acceptance together -- the rollback target. The legacy modelctl_commit/llama_cpp_commit/llama_cpp_upstream_base/acceptance_report keys are the same values under their old ambiguous names, kept for ci/checks.sh and older readers.
notes: Remediation pair. Fixes two output-corrupting defects and a set of silent control-plane degradations found by the 2026-07-31 review. Verified on this hardware: host cache/hybrid tests (also under ASan/UBSan), CPU-only capability truthfulness, schema-3 probe on the SYCL build, run_kquant.sh (cache output token-identical to baseline; hybrid deterministic), per-device budgets on a real MoE model, and the modelctl suite (1051 passed, 11 skipped). The full acceptance throughput matrix has NOT been re-run -- see the report's 'Not covered' section. Release A baselines predating today were produced with a broken -ot regex and are superseded.
